actionResult.summary: Review 218 revise-propose: I1-RP-001 is resolved. The checkpoint normalization authority is now exactly the approved EOF-only boundary: candidate/archive-touched text files may only collapse redundant EOF blank lines and ensure exactly one final newline; trailing spaces/tabs cleanup, internal/Markdown/semantic formatting, unrelated-file mutation and broad formatter execution are explicitly fail-closed. git diff --check and staged git diff --cached --check remain mandatory. The remaining 216 Proposal architecture, four capability deltas, performance/no-scheduler decisions and 16-selector apply/revise-apply mutation surface remain unchanged and consistent with the approved 214/215 Explore.
